contract.distance: norm of X/Z difference between vectors at actor+0x518 and actor+0x20

priority.if: ordered distance does not exceed scaled threshold

contract.validation_scope: finite inputs, argument and comparison dataflow, no full phase timing

notes: Compare and conditional branch are checked in the two words after each entry-reachable call.
Taken versus fallthrough is not advance versus hold: the destination code determines that meaning.
This gate is not the receiver reaction timer or the pose-pause clock.
